about_the_game:
A B-horror mystery comedy adventure game.
Having a crush on your bestie is hard enough without serial killers in the way! Lily's vacay plan to romance her crush Sally goes wrong when killers keep cropping up and ruining the mood. And that means war. "How dare you come between Sally and me!"

Characters

Lily

A posh college girl.

Sally

Lily's crush.

Lucy

A blonde girl who Lily meets on the trip.

Features

All But the Companions Are Shadows!

Anyone could be a killer. Everyone except the protagonist and her companions is shown as a silhouette.

Immersive camerawork in 2.5D

This game features 2.5D camerawork for more immersive exploration.

Ten Endings That Change Depending on You

What destiny Lily and Sally will face depends on the choices made by the player.

Partly adapted from the records of TRPG sessions

Chapter 1 of 2 has been substantially adapted from TRPG sessions that the developer played with friends. The TRPG script was originally written by "マリコロ" [Marikoro]. This adaptation was made with their consent.

Guidelines for Streams and Let's Plays

  • We are happy to have you stream our games or upload Let's Plays of them.

  • You may also monetize that gameplay, but only by using the features on online video platforms.

  • We would appreciate it if you would include the game name in the stream or Let's Play title, or put the Steam page link in the description.

  • We take no responsibility for any damage caused by your streams or Let's Plays.

  • These guidelines are subject to change without notice.

Note

This game uses character sprite materials from "わたおきば" [Wataokiba], which can be used for commercial purposes under their terms of use.
